fieldValues.title: Dream steps on small models (2026-11-20): summaries from a 3B to 8B model are judged close to haiku's, linking a vignette to what was derived from it needs a larger model, and routing by topic cannot be measured on the present tags
fieldValues.summary: Three steps of a dream were run on this repository's own records, which already carry the answers, with six small models through OpenRouter (1.7B to 8B), qwen2.5-7b on the local card and claude haiku as the reference (srs-programme#576, local-lab dream.mjs). A small model can draft a conversation's summary from its vignettes at almost no cost; only haiku clearly beats a word-overlap count at recognising which records came from a vignette; and on topic tags every model, haiku included, lands at the same low agreement, because the tags are incomplete.
evidence: Summarise (20 of 31 conversations with at least 3 vignettes; at most 60 words; one blind claude sonnet judge per summary, 180 judge calls, 0 judge failures). Unsupported statements per summary / summaries with none / vignettes covered / usable 1-5: haiku 0.20 / 16 of 20 / 75% / 3.7; granite-4.2-8b 0.25 / 16 / 72% / 3.5; ministral-3b 0.30 / 14 / 79% / 3.6; qwen2.5-7b local 0.30 / 14 / 65% / 3.1; llama-3.2-3b 0.40 / 12 / 62% / 3.0; ministral-8b 0.47 / 10 / 76% / 3.6 (1 failed reply); gemma-3-4b 0.56 / 9 / 71% / 3.4 (2 failed); lfm-3-1.7b 1.00 / 8 / 76% / 3.2
Summarise, word limit: haiku went over 60 words in 14 of 20 summaries, gemma-3-4b in 13, ministral-8b in 6, ministral-3b in 5, llama-3.2-3b in 3, granite and lfm in 1, qwen2.5-7b in none

Summarise, the summary already on each conversation note, judged the same way: 2.8 unsupported statements, 2 of 20 with none, 49% of vignettes covered, usable 2.9, 15 of 20 over 60 words. Not a fair rival: those summaries describe the whole conversation, and the judge saw only its vignettes

Link (100 vignettes that have a derived-from source, 170 true candidates; 8 candidates each, the true sources capped at 3 plus same-type records with the most word overlap; ids, dates, the word vignette and provenance fields stripped). Precision / recall / F1 / exact set: haiku 0.72 / 0.72 / 0.72 / 47%; qwen2.5-7b local 0.55 / 0.64 / 0.59 / 24%; granite-4.2-8b 0.51 / 0.65 / 0.57 / 23% (8 timeouts); ministral-8b 0.47 / 0.70 / 0.57 / 13%; ministral-3b 0.36 / 0.71 / 0.48 / 5%; gemma-3-4b 0.27 / 0.69 / 0.38 / 4%; lfm-3-1.7b 0.29 / 0.54 / 0.38 / 10% (38 empty replies); llama-3.2-3b 0.24 / 0.74 / 0.37 / 0%

Link, no model: picking the k candidates with the most word overlap, with k given as the true count, scores 0.51 / 0.51 / 0.51 and 38% exact. The three smallest models score below it; the 7B to 8B models are 0.06 to 0.08 above it, which is inside the noise at n = 100

Route (120 vignettes; closed list of 49 topic tags carried by at least 5 vignettes; 213 gold tags; at most 3 answers). F1 / share with one correct: haiku 0.40 / 76%; qwen2.5-7b local 0.40 / 59%; granite-4.2-8b 0.39 / 69%; lfm-3-1.7b 0.39 / 72%; ministral-8b 0.37 / 68%; ministral-3b 0.31 / 62%; gemma-3-4b 0.31 / 58%; llama-3.2-3b 0.19 / 17% with 82 of 120 calls failed at the provider

Route, two checks on the gold: always answering the three most common tags scores F1 0.15 (35% with one correct); and the models agree with each other more than with the tags (haiku and qwen 0.48, haiku and granite 0.51, qwen and granite 0.54, against 0.40 with the tags)
Route, answers outside the closed list (counted and dropped): qwen2.5-7b 133, llama-3.2-3b 63, gemma-3-4b 37, ministral-3b 19, ministral-8b 11, haiku 7, granite and lfm 0

Speed and cost: median seconds per item, route / link / summarise: ministral-3b 0.4 / 0.4 / 0.6; ministral-8b 0.4 / 0.4 / 1.0; qwen2.5-7b on the local 8 GB card 1.9 / 1.6 / 5.4; haiku 1.3 / 3.2 / 2.6; granite 17 / 38 / 18; lfm 7 / 17 / 4. All OpenRouter calls together cost about $0.32, the 180 judge calls about $2.9, haiku as a model about $0.17

Sizes of what was measured against: 361 vignettes; 284 carry a tag from the closed list; 203 have at least one derived-from source (508 edges); 40 conversation containers resolve to a conversation note, 31 with at least 3 vignettes
fieldValues.body:
Sources: local-lab commit 876a3d8, `dream.mjs` (`node dream.mjs --selftest` checks the scoring), `results/dream.<task>.<model>.json` with every reply, `results/dream.summary.json`, and the README section *Dream steps, 2026-11-20*. Only records of this public repository were sent to OpenRouter; nothing from srs-context, auto-memory or a transcript was.

## What it says

- **Summarise can move to a small model.** A 3B model at a twentieth of a cent per summary, or the 7B model on the local card for nothing, writes a summary a blind judge finds nearly as well supported as haiku's. The gap is at most one unsupported statement in three summaries for the better small models. A person or a larger model still reads it before it stands.
- **Link is where size shows.** Haiku is 0.13 F1 above the best small model and the only row clearly above counting shared words. The small models find most true sources (recall 0.64 to 0.74) and add many false ones, so their use here is a shortlist for a larger model, never the edge itself.
- **Route is not measured yet.** Every model lands in the same band and the models agree with each other more than with the tags, so the limit is the gold: tags were added by an agent as it worked and are incomplete. A sample of vignettes whose tags a person has checked would make this step measurable.
- **The local 7B model is disciplined about length and undisciplined about lists**: it never broke the word limit and it invented 133 topics outside a closed list.

## What was not measured

- The dream that runs today on srs-context (verdicts on inbox notes, re-verifying suspect records, the gold questions, rotating the brief). That memory is private and was not sent to a third party; these three steps are stand-ins built from public records.
- Whether the judge is right. One sonnet judge, no second rater, no human check of its counts.
- Linking against the whole repository. The task was eight candidates with one to three true; finding a source among thousands is harder.
- Repeats. One run, one seed, 20 to 120 items: gaps under 0.05 to 0.1 are noise.
- Gemma 4 E4B, which OpenRouter does not serve and the local ollama is too old to run.

## Caveats on the numbers

- Summarise input was cut to 600 characters per vignette (12 of 20 conversations had at least one cut) so the local model's 8192-token window held; the judge saw up to 3,000 characters per vignette, so coverage is judged against more text than the writer saw.
- The link baseline is told how many candidates are true, which no model was; the distractors were chosen by the same word overlap, which works against the baseline.
- llama-3.2-3b's route row is a provider failure under a strict JSON schema, not a reading of the model.
- The repository holds near-duplicate records; copies of a true source were removed from the distractors.
